subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 27, September 17th, 2026, Software drafts your lab result note.
body:
Software drafts your lab result note.

Carousel No. 27, September 17th, 2026

Did NOT meet the bar: 6.856 against 8.0. Read before posting.

machine QAPASS, 9 slides, zero fails, zero warns
claimsPASS, 42 verified claims, 5 absences with method, 8 rejected findings
numeralsPASS, 27 numerals over 9 frames, every one reachable from a claim its frame cites
aggregatesPASS, 5 declarations, every one re-derived
deck coherencePASS, mean adjacent jump 8.31 against a 14.9 ceiling, no hard cut
layoutPASS, the rotation holds and the accent is used with restraint
constructionPASS, 4 of 9 frames share the plate primitive, under the 50% line
plan vs renderPASS, 9 of 70 acceptance items machine-checkable and every one holds
verbatimPASS, 9 declared fragments, every one a literal substring of its own claim's quote
locatorsPASS, 8 locators carried by claims, 0 untraced
captionPASS, 148 words, 900 characters, clean against every house rule
sources blockPASS, every claim id the deck prints resolves to a document
sitePASS, house_style, site_fresh, media, seo, schema, schema_contract, port_audit all clean
shipped_checkPASS across every published run
ledgersPASS, topics, artwork and captions agree with their own entries
ownershipPASS, 343 paths all inside the daily lane
completionPASS, the deck shipped on the 5 round cap
scoreSTALE, and the run record says exactly why and by how much

What degraded

  • THE DECK SHIPPED UNDER THE BAR. 6.856 against 8.0, a shortfall of 1.144, on the five round cap with zero hard fails standing. That is the one path under the threshold that is not a failure, and it is only that because the run did five rounds of work.
  • Frame 2 is cuttable on FIVE independent judge readings across five rounds. This run chose not to restructure a nine frame deck at round 5 and recorded the disagreement rather than settling it.
  • Frame 3 still reads poorly at feed size after four rounds. Its projection arithmetic now checks to the pixel and two judges still called the monitor a floor lamp. Nothing measures recognisability.
  • Frame 9's halftone reserve was repaired in the source string and never reached the pixels, because lineBoxes reads live geometry and the card is positioned after the canvas work. The deck's one screen still runs under the accent card's type.
  • Frame 7 omits subsection (f)'s opening trigger clause, which is what makes (f) the health care provision. Two integrity judges disagreed about whether the lowercase opening already marks the cut.
  • Four bleeds declarations disagree with the drawn sheets. layout_check measures the dossier's rect and passes; two craft judges measured the N.sheet call and did not.
  • gov.texas.gov now disallows this crawler across the whole host where the registry records that it serves none. Nothing was fetched from it. The registry is human lane, so the decision is yours.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Software drafts your lab result note., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

At Memorial Hermann in Houston, software writes the note before the clinician does.

The assistant is built into Epic and drafts the note a patient gets with a lab result. The clinician can review and edit it.

The system reports 32% fewer follow-up messages when clinicians started from the draft, and nine seconds saved per result comment. healthsystemCIO wrote on September 10th that the figures come from Epic and its customer, and that the 32% counts clinicians who chose it.

Section 552.051 took effect January 1st. Subsection (b) puts its disclosure duty on a governmental agency. Subsection (f) puts it on the provider of the service or treatment. Chapter 552 has no section headed Applicability.

Nine slides go from the announcement to the statute. Ask who wrote the note, before a first visit.

Does subsection (f) reach a hospital that is not an agency?

#Houston #HB149 #MemorialHermann
